The refunds match W2's report, and the net balances check out against the orders (acme 20065 - 14546 = 5519, birch 15118 - 1481 = 13637, cobalt 53824 with no refunds). Recording the first payout for acme.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch's net balance is 13637 cents, which matches the orders and refunds I checked, so I'll record that payout next.
Cobalt's net balance is 53824 cents, which matches orders 252 (36165) and 255 (17659) with no refunds. All three balances check out, so I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts were recorded successfully after the refunds table matched W2's report and each net balance checked out against the orders. Reporting the batch as complete.
